notes.title: !! DEMO NOW AVAILABLE !!!
notes.content:
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31132935/5f2f987a5ba03ceb296285d59e7d28947a6e83cf.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31132935/882627dfb7565903d98ca3f19b0ad4bf94c1f1f3.png[/img][/url]

You can now try our revolutionary new moment system for free!  The demo includes all the tutorials and a Jungle Gym to swing around in.  If your feeling more adventurous the paid version will provide death-match capabilities and the first campaign chapter. 

We are looking to get as much feedback as possible to help make this the best game it can be so please report bugs to support@cronoforge.com.  If you have any comments or feedback be sure to write them in the review section.

Thanks for your support!!

notes.title: Game Update 1.0
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31132935/7c43809cab3605e30606dc0e237fedd80e944a68.png[/img]

Our first update is now live! 

- Added Analytics
- Fixed Bullet sometimes going through walls
- Fixed Wall collision so Drones less likely to go out of bounds
- Campaign Clear Drones on Death to increase performance
- Added Punch Voice Queue to first door
- Minor Bug Fixes to stages

We are also accepting beta tester applications.  If you like first person shooters and would like to be a part of the multiplayer beta test send us an email at contact@cronoforge.com.  Tell us a bit about your experience with FPS and Virtual Reality, only those selected will be contacted.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Launch Day: November 21st !!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31132935/3654234f45177eef6a3b0872203ff7186816a000.png[/img]

We have submitted our game to steam and have an official launch day!

There are new images in the gallery:
http://www.operationpolarityhook.com/gallery

I have started work on designing the game mechanics for multiplayer.  There are many unique challenges to making a multiplayer game that will work with our new movement and combat systems.  Once I have sorted out how we will resolve most of them the coding fun begins!  The first update that goes out will address any bugs that may pop up.  We will also add a few items and features that didn't make it into the initial build. 

I'm hoping to get the first update out in mid December, keep an eye out for it!
